label: pH probe
description: Atlas Scientific EZO-pH circuit with a pH probe, on the I²C bus.

calibration.label: Midpoint (pH 7)
calibration.instruction: Rinse the probe in distilled water, put it in pH 7.00 buffer and wait until the reading stops drifting (1–2 minutes). The midpoint clears any earlier calibration.

calibration.label: Low point (pH 4)
calibration.instruction: Rinse, put the probe in pH 4.00 buffer and wait for the reading to settle.

calibration.label: High point (pH 10)
calibration.instruction: Rinse, put the probe in pH 10.00 buffer and wait for the reading to settle.

label: Conductivity (EC) probe
description: Atlas Scientific EZO-EC circuit with a conductivity probe, on the I²C bus.

calibration.label: Dry
calibration.instruction: Dry the probe completely and hold it in air.

calibration.label: Reference solution
calibration.instruction: Put the probe in the reference solution (1.413 mS/cm = 1413 µS/cm unless yours says otherwise), tap out bubbles and wait for the reading to settle.

label: Water temperature probe
description: Atlas Scientific EZO-RTD circuit with a PT-1000 probe, on the I²C bus.

calibration.label: Reference temperature
calibration.instruction: Put the probe in water of a known temperature (an ice-water bath is 0 °C) and wait for the reading to settle.
